recognize_zh: 組合圖：A 為紅血球為主的周邊血液抹片，白血球極少；B 骨髓切片可見大片由組織球構成的肉芽腫病灶；C 高倍見上皮樣組織球與多核巨細胞；D 以銀染（GMS）顯示多個小型圓至卵圓形、染成黑褐色的酵母菌，符合莢膜組織漿菌（Histoplasma）。
features: Panel A: peripheral blood smear with red cells and very few leukocytes or platelets in the field
Panel B: bone marrow biopsy with extensive pale granulomatous areas replacing hematopoietic marrow between trabeculae
Panel C: epithelioid histiocytes and multinucleated giant cells forming non-necrotizing granulomas with admixed inflammatory cells
Panel D: silver stain showing numerous small round to oval dark yeast forms, uniform in size
Low-resolution composite; budding and capsule-like halo cannot be assessed
describe_en: This composite figure shows a peripheral blood smear (A) with red cells and very few leukocytes or platelets in the field, in keeping with pancytopenia. The bone marrow core biopsy (B) shows extensive granulomatous inflammation replacing hematopoietic tissue, and at higher power (C) the granulomas are composed of epithelioid histiocytes and multinucleated giant cells without obvious necrosis. A Grocott methenamine silver stain (D) highlights numerous small, uniform, round to oval yeast forms. The findings are consistent with granulomatous marrow involvement by disseminated histoplasmosis; culture, urine/serum antigen testing, or PCR can confirm the species.

ddx.vs: Cryptococcus yeasts are larger and more variable in size, with a thick mucicarmine-positive capsule and narrow-based budding.
Leishmania amastigotes have a kinetoplast visible on Giemsa and are GMS-negative.
Mycobacteria are acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain and do not appear as round yeasts on GMS.
Non-infectious granulomas lack organisms on GMS and acid-fast stains.
